_what_this_is: The stack-specific half of the harness, in one file.
ci.py is the step ladder - the same in every factory. What is NOT the same is
every command it runs, and those live here. Leave a step empty and it is SKIPPED
_unit_count_pattern: One group capturing how many tests passed. node --test prints 'ℹ pass N'. Zero is not a pass.

browser._note: The E2E and holdout drive headless Chrome over CDP (harness/browser.mjs), the pattern from letter-islands. install_check runs at setup via factory_doctor.
browser.install_hint: Install Google Chrome, or set CHROME to another Chromium binary
